faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology Allahabad (MNNIT Allahabad) for a research project position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The post announced in this official notification is Project Associate-I under the Department of Applied Mechanics.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the duly completed offline application form is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for MNNIT Allahabad recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply through offline mode by sending the filled application form via post along with required documents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary provided for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate-I post will receive a consolidated salary of 40,000/- per month as per funding agency norms.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.E or M.Tech/M.E degree in relevant engineering branches such as Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, and allied disciplines.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified or requested in the official recruitment notification released by MNNIT Allahabad.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form must be sent to the Research & Consultancy Cell, MNNIT Allahabad, Prayagraj-211004 within the stipulated deadline.
